### [`compose_buffer_last`](../../../../src/graphics/compose_buffer_end.asm#L9) `$0800`

*variable*

Last byte of the fighter composition buffer $05ca-$0800 (63 rows of 9 bytes).
$88ca clears it and $88da and $8923 write it.
